##### Project general facts

Azizi Amir by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with stylish architecture, modern facade geometry and premium finishes inside and out. The building rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, creating a calm, low-rise setting within an established community. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed with an emphasis on comfort and functionality for couples, professionals and growing families.

Residents enjoy separate swimming pools for adults and children, a modern fitness centre and a private cinema for relaxed evenings at home. An indoor children's play area, a sun terrace, an outdoor relaxation area, landscaped open spaces and walking paths create welcoming places to unwind, while a stylish lobby, lifts, spacious parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance add everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Residences combine spacious living rooms, well-planned layouts and large windows that fill each room with natural light, while high-quality finishes create a cosy and stylish atmosphere. Kitchens are thoughtfully equipped, making every home practical for daily life and entertaining. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is an established family-friendly community in western Dubai, known for its mix of villas, townhouses and low-rise apartment buildings in Arabic, Mediterranean and contemporary styles. Landscaped parks, playgrounds, sports courts, cycling and jogging tracks and community retail centres with cafes, supermarkets and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a calm, green character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Discovery Gardens metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall and the Jebel Ali Free Zone are a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Business Bay and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Furjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular family-oriented addresses in western Dubai. Metro access, mature infrastructure and proximity to Dubai Marina and the Jebel Ali Free Zone attract families and professionals, supporting high occupancy. Spacious apartments in low-rise buildings and competitive prices underpin steady rental demand and long-term value for owners.
